cards.audioText: [Your call-sign is UAL887, a passenger flight from Tokyo to Guangzhou. You are now flying at 9500m, estimating OBLIK at 35, squawking 5355. Make an initial contact with Beijing Control.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你的呼号是美联航887，一架从东京飞往广州的客运航班。你现在在9500米飞行，预计过OBLIK时间35分，应答机5355。与北京区调进行初始联系。】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Control, UAL887, 9500m maintaining, ETA OBLIK 35, squawk 5355.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京区调，美联航887，正保持在9500米，预计过OBLIK时间35分，应答机5355。

cards.audioText: C: UAL887, Beijing Control, radar contact, maintain present altitude, no speed restriction.
cards.audioTextZh: C: 美联航887，北京区调，雷达看见了，保持当前高度，没有速度限制。
cards.referenceText: Maintain present altitude, no speed restriction, UAL887.
cards.referenceTextZh: 保持当前高度，没有速度限制，美联航887。

cards.audioText: [You have an indication of cumulonimbus about 40km ahead, therefore, you want to turn right to go round it.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【前方40公里处显示有积雨云，因此，你想右转绕飞。】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Control, UAL887, we have an indication of CB about 40km ahead, request turn right to avoid it.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京区调，美联航887，前方40公里处显示有积雨云，请求右转绕飞。

cards.audioText: C: UAL887, turning right is not approved due prohibited area, turn left 30 degrees, track out 35km, report clear of the build-up.
cards.audioTextZh: C: 美联航887，不行，由于禁区，左转30度，出航35公里，离开积雨云后报。
cards.referenceText: Turn left 30 degrees, track out 35km, wilco, UAL887.
cards.referenceTextZh: 左转30度，出航35公里，照办，美联航887。

cards.audioText: [You are now clear of cumulonimbus and closing back to your original course, report to the controller.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你现在离开积雨云，正返回原航路，告知管制员。】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Control, UAL887, clear of CB and returning back to our original course.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京区调，美联航887，离开积雨云，正返回原航路。

cards.audioText:
C: UAL887, Beijing Control, roger, report joining.
[Later...]
[A flight attendant reports that a pregnant woman is about to deliver a baby, and she is in severe pain. Inform Beijing Control the situation. This is an emergency call.]
cards.audioTextZh:
C:美联航887，北京区调，收到，加入后报。
【后来...】
【一名乘务员报告说一名怀孕乘客要生孩子，她现在疼得厉害。告知北京区调，这是一个紧急呼叫。】
cards.referenceText: Panpan Panpan Panpan, Beijing Control, UAL887, a pregnant woman is on board is about to deliver a baby, she is in severe pain.
cards.referenceTextZh: Panpan Panpan Panpan，北京区调，美联航887，一名怀孕乘客将要在飞机上生孩子，她现在疼得厉害。

cards.audioText:
C: UAL887, Beijing Control, roger that. Notify us the further situation and your intention.
[Tell controller that the pure oxygen is being fed to the woman, and she is about to give birth on the plane. You want to divert to Wuhan.]
cards.audioTextZh:
C: 美联航887，北京区调，收到。告知情况的发展以及你的意图。
【告知管制员，已经给乘客提供纯氧，她打算在飞机上生孩子。你想备降到武汉。】
cards.referenceText: The pure oxygen is being fed to the woman, and she is about to give birth on the plane, request divert to Wuhan, UAL887.
cards.referenceTextZh: 已经给乘客提供纯氧，她打算在飞机上生孩子，请求改航到武汉，美联航887。

cards.audioText: C: UAL887, roger that. You are cleared to divert to Wuhan. Turn right heading 216 and descend to 8100m.
cards.audioTextZh: C: 美联航887，收到。你可以改航到武汉。右转航向216，下8100米。
cards.referenceText: Cleared to divert to Wuhan, turn right heading 216 and descend to 8100m, UAL887.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以改航到武汉，右转航向216，下8100米，美联航887。

cards.audioText: [Make a passenger address to find if any doctor or nurse is available to offer help.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【进行机上广播，看是否能找到医生或护士。】
cards.referenceText: Ladies and gentlemen, this is your captain speaking: a female passenger is about to give birth on the plane, so if you are a doctor or nurse, please kindly offer some help, thank you so much!
cards.referenceTextZh: 女士们，先生们，这里是机长广播：一名女性乘客将要在飞机上生孩子，因此如果你是医生或者护士，请提供帮助，谢谢。

cards.audioText:
[15 minutes later.]
[Tell controller that the baby is delivered safely, but the mother has fainted, request landing as soon as possible.]
cards.audioTextZh:
【15分钟后。】
【告知管制员，孩子成功出生，但是妈妈已经昏迷，请求尽快着陆。】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Control, UAL887, the baby has been delivered safely, but the mother lost consciousness, request landing as soon as possible.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京区调，美联航887，孩子安全出生，但是妈妈失去意识，请求尽快着陆。

cards.audioText: C: UAL887, Beijing Control, roger your information. Further descend to 5100m, contact Wuhan Approach 126.3.
cards.audioTextZh: C: 美联航887，北京区调，收到你的情报。继续下到5100 米，联系武汉进近126.3。
cards.referenceText: Descend to 5100m, contact Wuhan Approach on 126.3, UAL887.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下到5100米，联系武汉进近126.3，美联航887。

cards.audioText: [Contact Wuhan Approach and ask controller to arrange doctor and ambulance on arrival.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【联系武汉进近，请求管制员安排医生和救护车在着陆后就位。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, UAL887, request doctor and ambulance on arrival.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，美联航887，请求着陆后医生和救护车就位。

cards.audioText: C: UAL887, Wuhan Approach, radar contact, radar vectors for ILS approach runway 04R.
cards.audioTextZh: C: 美联航887，武汉进近，雷达看到了，雷达引导盲降进近跑道04右。
cards.referenceText: Radar vectors for ILS approach runway 04R, UAL887.
cards.referenceTextZh: 雷达引导，盲降进近跑道04右，美联航887。

cards.audioText: C: UAL887, turn left heading 190, descend to and maintain 3600m on QNH 1006, reduce to minimum approach speed.
cards.audioTextZh: C: 美联航887，左转航向190，下到3600米保持，修压1006，减小到最低进近速度。
cards.referenceText: Turn left heading 190, descend to and maintain 3600m on QNH1006, reduce to minimum approach speed, UAL887.
cards.referenceTextZh: 左转航向190，下到3600米保持，修压1006，减小到最低进近速度，美联航887。

cards.audioText: C: UAL887, descend to 1200m, turn right heading 226 to intercept the localizer runway 04R, report established.
cards.audioTextZh: 美联航887，下1200米，右转航向226来截获跑道04右航向道，截获后报。
cards.referenceText: Descend to 1200m, turn right heading 226 to intercept the localizer runway 04R, wilco, UAL887.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向226来截获跑道04右航向道，美联航887。

cards.audioText: [Now you have intercepted the localizer of runway 04R, inform Tower controller. ]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你现在已经截获跑道04右航向道，告知塔台管制员。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, UAL887, intercepted the localizer of runway 04R.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，美联航887，截获跑道04右航向道。

cards.audioText: C: UAL887, Wuhan Tower, continue approach, runway 04R, report outer marker.
cards.audioTextZh: C: 美联航887，武汉塔台，继续进近，跑道04右，过外指点标后报。
cards.referenceText: Continue approach, runway 04R, wilco, UAL887.
cards.referenceTextZh: 继续进近，跑道04右，照办，美联航887。

cards.audioText: [Now you are over outer marker.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你现在已经过了外指点标。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, UAL887, over outer marker.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，美联航887，过外指点标。

cards.audioText: C: UAL887, cleared to land, runway 04R, surface wind 170, 13m/s, QNH1006, report vacated.
cards.audioTextZh: C: 美联航887，可以落地，跑道04右，地面风170度，13米每秒，修压1006，脱离后报。
cards.referenceText: Cleared to land, runway 04R, QNH1006, wilco, UAL887.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以落地，跑道04右，修压1006，照办，美联航887。

cards.audioText: [During landing, you hear a loud bang and the plane bounces. You suspect the plane has encountered a tail strike. Inform this to the controller and request ground staff to have a visual check of your tail section at the gate.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【在着陆中，你听到了一声巨响，飞机弹跳。你怀疑飞机遇到了擦机尾。告知管制员该情况，请求地面人员在你到达机位后目视检查机尾部分。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, UAL887, we hear a loud bang and the plane bounces during landing, suspect a tail strike, request ground staff to have a visual check of our tail section at the gate.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，美联航887，我们听到了一声巨响，飞机弹跳，怀疑飞机遇到了擦机尾，请求地面人员在机位目视检查机尾部分。

cards.audioText: C: UAL887, roger, vacate runway via fast exit J4, contact Wuhan Ground on 118.025.
cards.audioTextZh: 美联航887，收到，经由快速脱离道J4脱离，联系武汉地面118.025。
cards.referenceText: Vacate runway via fast exit J4, contact Wuhan Ground on 118.025, UAL887.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经由快速脱离道J4脱离，联系武汉地面118.025，美联航887。
